identification_strategy: One-line: DID — treatment = educational intervention in early grades, control = educational intervention in later grades; shock/instrument/cutoff = null
conclusion_detail: The effect of educational interventions on test scores tends to fade out over time.
main_effect: The variance in accumulated knowledge increases by between 37 and 56 percent from the end of kindergarten to the end of high school.
key_robustness: Use of both administrative and survey data
notes: The paper discusses potential statistical artifacts affecting the results, and the sample period is not specified, which affects the confidence level.
